name: @bonezegei/bzui
description: bzUI (Bonezegei UI): zero-dependency CSS design tokens, animations and the bzChart.js canvas chart engine for Bonezegei.js apps.
author: Bonezegei

scripts.build: esbuild src/js/bzChart.js --minify --format=esm --outfile=dist/bzChart.min.js && esbuild src/js/bzui-chart.js --minify --format=esm --outfile=dist/bzui-chart.min.js && esbuild src/js/bzui-code.js --minify --format=esm --outfile=dist/bzui-code.min.js && esbuild src/js/bzui-code-bsl.js --minify --format=esm --outfile=dist/bzui-code-bsl.min.js && esbuild src/js/bzui-draw.js --minify --format=esm --outfile=dist/bzui-draw.min.js && esbuild vendor/Bonezegei.js --minify --format=esm --outfile=dist/Bonezegei.min.js && esbuild src/css/bzui.css --minify --outfile=dist/bzui.min.css && esbuild src/css/bzui-code.css --minify --outfile=dist/bzui-code.min.css && esbuild src/css/bzui-draw.css --minify --outfile=dist/bzui-draw.min.css && esbuild src/css/bzui-icons.css --minify --outfile=dist/bzui-icons.min.css && esbuild src/css/bzui-icons-brands.css --minify --outfile=dist/bzui-icons-brands.min.css
